question: Who has been appointed as the Chairman of the BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harvansh Chawla.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Harvansh Chawla, a senior lawyer and international trade expert, has been appointed as Chairman of the BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harvansh Chawla has been appointed as Chairman of the BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI).**
 
• His leadership focuses on strengthening trade, investment, and economic cooperation among BRICS and BRICS Plus nations.
 
• Chawla’s vision includes reducing trade barriers, fostering cross-border partnerships, and promoting innovation in various sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• BRICS Chamber of Commerce & Industry (CCI)__

 __
 
• Aims to promote trade and economic growth among BRICS nations and emerging economies.
 
• Helps foster collaboration and partnership across sectors such as finance, technology, and infrastructure.
 
 
 
• BRICS and BRICS Plus__
 __
 
• BRICS includes Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.
 
• BRICS Plus includes countries beyond BRICS, focusing on enhanced collaboration with emerging economies.
 
 
 
• Harvansh Chawla’s Background__
 
 
• A senior lawyer with expertise in international trade law and policy.
 
• Known for his work in fostering cross-border trade relations and economic development.
